snippet.title: One Military Camp - Console Trailer (PS5 & Xbox Series X/S)
snippet.description:
One Military Camp is finally deploying to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S! An evil maniac has conquered almost everything. The only way to push back his forces is to revive an old, abandoned base: One Military Camp. Get ready to plunge into this humorous strategy and management sim where you must:
BUILD YOUR BASE: Design and build an efficient military camp, managing power, logistics, and resources to keep everything running like clockwork.
TRAIN YOUR TROOPS: Recruit brave misfits and put them through rigorous, specialized training to turn them into elite soldiers: from spies and snipers to medics and grenadiers.
MANAGE EVERYTHING: Handle staff schedules, maintenance, and the well-being of your recruits (keep the morale high, or they'll get injured!).
COMPLETE MISSIONS: Send your balanced squads on missions across the map to recover territory, gain resources, and ultimately end the war!
CUSTOMIZE: Make the camp your own with custom flags, signs… you can even edit every recruit. 
Featuring a wacky sense of humor and references to classic war movies and games, this base-builder is an accessible and addictive challenge. One Military Camp on console introduces a new control system optimized for gamepad, and up to 4K resolution  Prepare for deployment! One Military Camp is coming soon to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S!
